origin: Major Atmospheric Gamma Imaging Cherenkov Telescope Project (La Palma)

g.name: Gamma (signal)
g.description: High-energy gamma rays from point sources; produce elongated, compact elliptical Cherenkov showers pointing to the camera origin.

h.name: Hadron (background)
h.description: Hadronic cosmic rays in upper atmosphere; produce diffuse, irregular, and broader Cherenkov cascades.

features.name: fLength
features.description: Major axis length of the reconstructed Hillas ellipse

features.name: fWidth
features.description: Minor axis width of the reconstructed Hillas ellipse

features.name: fSize
features.description: Base-10 logarithm of the total photon count collected by all PMT pixels

features.name: fConc
features.description: Ratio of the sum of the two highest pixel signals over fSize

features.name: fConc1
features.description: Ratio of the highest single pixel signal over fSize

features.name: fAsym
features.description: Distance from the highest pixel to center along the major axis

features.name: fM3Long
features.description: Cubic root of the third moment along the major axis (skewness indicator)

features.name: fM3Trans
features.description: Cubic root of the third moment along the minor axis

features.name: fAlpha
features.description: Angle between the major axis and vector from camera center to ellipse center (Gammas tend towards 0 deg)

features.name: fDist
features.description: Distance from the camera origin to the center of the shower ellipse
